Subject: category theory | ID: 24546

Statement

Step 1. Consider the skew-symmetric operator \(A_{01270011}\) acting on the symmetric space. By the skew-symmetric decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|A_{01270011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01270011\).

Step 2. By the idempotent spectral theorem, we decompose \(P_{01270012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the idempotent spectral family.

Step 3. Applying the uniform interpolation theorem to \(S_{01270013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via nonlinear interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
